introduction.text: V. Knorre found Koronis at Berlin in 1876. It lends its name to a family whose spins were measured from 213 light curves.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.summary: Shape from brightness changes as it spins, sized by a stellar occultation. The spin angle shown is arbitrary.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 19 km sphere, sharing the size uncertainty. Colors mix the overall shape with local relief.
